    Skerry Light

    In the winter of 1887 the lamp at Skerry Light failed, and the keeper's wife, Maren Holm, rowed out with a lantern to warn the brig Gannet. The Gannet broke up on the rocks. Maren's skiff came back empty.

    Sail together · up to 8 ships

    Looking for other sailors…

      The story, and how to play

      She still stands on the water when the lamp turns, nearer every turn, and she follows any ship she has chosen. The Gannet's drowned crew swim with her, and her figurehead, Knock, walks the water with a belaying pin. The only thing Maren will not come near is Plimsoll, the shark who walked out of the surf that winter in the Gannet cabin boy's blue shoes. He knows the deep water through the skerries, but he won't wait for you. Follow his shoes.

      • See rocks, wrecks and drifting timber show only while the beam or a flare is on them, then they are gone
      • Follow Plimsoll's glowing shoes. Sail close behind him (within 45 m) and Maren holds where she is. Fall behind and he soon walks on alone
      • Ring the bell (Space) with her anywhere ahead of you (anywhere at all once she's close) to drive her back three stages. It also sinks the drowned and freezes Knock. It swings again in about 15 seconds
      • The drowned swim after you; their eyes catch the light. Sail fast to shake them off, or ring the bell. Plimsoll sometimes snaps one up
      • Knock moves only while you can't see him. Listen for three knocks on wood, turn, and keep him in your light. The bell freezes him
      • Flare (F) lights everything around you for a few seconds, for your whole crew
      • Steer ← → or A / D, sail ↑ ↓ or W / S. On a phone, hold the left or right side to steer and use the ▲ ▼ buttons for speed
      • Boats the Brig takes three hits, the quick Cutter two, the heavy Barque five. Glancing off a rock only slows you; hitting it head on costs a plank.
      • Hull when the planks run out she goes down. Let Maren reach the bow and she comes aboard
      • Verity sometimes you'll find a smiling yellow orb on your deck, right in front of you, offering to help. He isn't helping, and the bell doesn't bother him. Fire a flare before twenty seconds are up, or see what he really looks like
      • The Backrooms about one voyage in twenty, the lights go out and the sea comes back with walls: a flooded maze of yellow rooms. Follow Plimsoll to the green EXIT sign
      • Crew sail with up to seven friends. Ships close together keep her back and patch each other's planks. Share flares, chat in the crew screen, and watch your crew after your own voyage ends

          Boats and Crates

          Pick your boat. Each voyage earns a Skerry Crate, one if you go down and two when you make harbour. Any crate can hold a skin for any boat, a flag or a flare colour. If you see gold in the reel, it's yours.
